description: Verify rendered browser screenshot by decoding a PNG with the Python standard library, sampling pixels on a grid (and optionally sampling block cells), and returning blank/content/blockiness metrics.

path.description: Relative or absolute path to the PNG screenshot file to verify. No organization-specific hostnames or credentials are accepted.

block_cols.description: Optional number of blocks to divide the image into horizontally for block-structure verification.

block_rows.description: Optional number of blocks to divide the image into vertically for block-structure verification.

outputs.color_type: PNG color type used by the screenshot.
outputs.bit_depth: PNG bit depth used by the screenshot.
outputs.blank: True when the sampled pixels are all very dark/empty or all very bright/empty.
outputs.blank_ratio: Fraction of sampled pixels classified as blank.
outputs.uniform_blocks: Fraction of blocks whose sampled pixels are visually uniform.
outputs.mean_rgb: Mean RGB of sampled pixels, always in 0..255.
outputs.mean_luma: Mean perceived brightness of sampled pixels.
outputs.verdict: blank, incorrect, sparse, or content based on blank/blockiness/sampling ratio.

tests.setup:
import zlib, struct
def png_chunk(typ, data):
    return struct.pack('>I', len(data)) + typ + data + struct.pack('>I', zlib.crc32(typ + data) & 0xffffffff)

def raw_png(width, height, rows):
    raw = bytearray()
    for row in rows:
        raw.extend(b'\x00')
        for (r,g,b) in row:
            raw.extend(struct.pack('>BBB', r,g,b))
    idat = zlib.compress(bytes(raw), 9)
    sig = b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'
    ihdr = struct.pack('>IIBBBBB', width, height, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0)
    ihdr_c = png_chunk(b'IHDR', ihdr)
    idat_c = png_chunk(b'IDAT', idat)
    iend_c = png_chunk(b'IEND', b'')
    return sig + ihdr_c + idat_c + iend_c

with open('blank.png','wb') as f:
    f.write(raw_png(6,6,[[ (0,0,0) for _ in range(6)] for _ in range(6)]))
